mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% indicates a weak labor market that depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE is above 9.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) and high unemployment (above 9.5%) signals a weak economy with accommodative monetary policy failing to stimulate growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 9.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong housing starts (HOUST) and robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicate sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in late-cycle expansion regimes when HOUST and RSAFS are both above their 50th percentiles over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 99.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is below 99.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 550,000 units signals strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST is above 550,000 units over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL above 217.0), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 217.0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity across both the residential and manufacturing sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST and INDPRO both increase by more than 0.5% month-over-month over any 3-year rolling window.
